name: api_sync_totals
description: Fetches all users (paginated) and each user's orders from the local JSON API with 429/Retry-After retry, caches raw data to api_cache.json in the project dir, and writes totals.json (sum of completed order amounts per user id). Returns counts.
whenToUse: To pull/refresh the API data; later questions can read api_cache.json instead of re-fetching.

provenance.reason: paginated API plus per-user orders with rate limiting
